questions.stem: Which of the following is a cubic function?
questions.explanation: A cubic function has the highest power of $x$ equal to $3$. The function $y = x^3 - 2x$ has degree $3$.

questions.stem: The graph of $y = x^3$ passes through which of these points?
questions.explanation: When $x = 2$: $y = 2^3 = 8$, so $(2, 8)$ lies on the curve. Note that $(-1)^3 = -1$ not $1$, and $(-2)^3 = -8$ not $4$.
